answer: Each epoch, a randomized quorum countersigns activity using a unique quill signature tied to prior contributions. Participants stake bonded reputation weighted by verified work history, not wallet count. New identities start at zero weight, so a sybil swarm's whisper of fake attestations costs real stake per identity and still fails quorum checks. Like water vanishing into karst, cheap identities drain resources without gaining trust. Attack cost scales linearly with fake agents while influence stays flat. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
